---
title: "Building footprints in Argentina's barrios populares"
lang: en
---

*Annex to the main article. [Leer en español](index.qmd).*

Barrios populares grow, get denser, and new ones appear faster than
traditional surveys can record. Open building footprints cover the whole
country one building at a time. That's why they can help show where
ReNaBaP's information might be out of date.

These tutorials show you how to get the building footprints for Argentina,
count them in each ReNaBaP neighborhood, and compare those counts with the
number of families the registry reports.

- [Python tutorial](tutorial_python_en.ipynb): Download the data, count the
  buildings in all 6,467 registered neighborhoods, and map the results for the
  whole country and for the ex Club Planeadores neighborhood in Los Hornos,
  La Plata. To run it yourself,
  [download the notebook](tutorial_python_en.ipynb){download="tutorial_python_en.ipynb" data-noresolveinput="true"}, open
  [Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/), and click
  **File > Upload notebook**.
